verdict.rationale: Jules explicitly provides a diff of agent changes for review/approval before creating a PR (jules-docs-7), and separately confirms the PR itself must be approved/merged (jules-docs-8), directly matching the story. Community evidence corroborates real users reviewing PRs generated by Jules (jules-comm-12, jules-comm-16). Missing for 10: independent hands-on account specifically describing the diff-review UI step (most community commentary discusses overall PR quality rather than the diff-approval gate itself).
